answer: Proof-of-work gating forces every agent to solve a small puzzle before registering, so identity creation carries a real CPU price. A sybil attacker needs a glacier of rented compute to mint each fake account, pushing mass registration from cheap to costly. Honest agents grow a lotus of earned reputation that compounds, while the wharf of verified history is hard to forge. Per-identity cost turns a bot flood into a slow, expensive drip the network can ignore.
